claim: The contemporaneous guide specifies ACK with the top topic-branch commit followed by an account of the review.

span.quote:
starting with `ACK BRANCH_COMMIT`, where `BRANCH_COMMIT` is the top of the
topic branch. The review is followed by a description of how the reviewer did
the review.

limits_and_alternatives: A documented convention does not establish its enforcement in every review.

claim: practicalswift asks paymog to identify the reviewed version by adding its hash after ACK.

span.quote: Don't forget to include the commit hash after your ACK to specify which version of the PR you are ACK:ing

limits_and_alternatives: Local review coordination is explicit; no sanction is stated.

claim: paymog acknowledges the reminder and supplies a hash-specific ACK in a later comment.

span.quote: @practicalswift got it. Thanks for the patience.

limits_and_alternatives: The separate response supports local uptake. No population compliance rate or durable internalized belief follows.

claim: The body describes a software precondition, which supplies no institutional duty by itself.

span.quote: The fuzzing harness did not fulfil that pre-condition prior to this commit

limits_and_alternatives: Technical requires should not be converted to an institutional obligation without a separate governance claim.
